id: title:EDsCODE:batch ducklake add data files registration

observations.behavior: Replaces a single bulk Parquet glob and metadata scan with batched, per-path `CALL ducklake_add_data_files` invocations.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces the risk of long-running or stalling DuckLake metadata operations during warehouse ingestion; relevant to PostHog's managed warehouse connector reliability.

observations.behavior: Adds an explicit batch size parameter and its use in chunking file paths before invoking catalog commands.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides bounded transaction sizes and clearer failure isolation within warehouse registration workflows.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that each execution call receives only one path rather than a full glob, and checks multiple batches are produced. No longer asserts on the presence of the parquet glob pattern.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks implementation correctness and guards against regression if batching behavior changes.

observations.limitations: Only documentation and workflow-layer code is shown; no runtime performance measurements, compatibility notes, or broader system dependency analysis. The tier relies solely on observed batching and test assertions without independent benefit claims.

review.limitations: Only documentation and workflow-layer code is shown; no runtime performance measurements, compatibility notes, or broader system dependency analysis. The tier relies solely on observed batching and test assertions without independent benefit claims.
review.reason: The change demonstrates a substantive improvement: it replaces a potentially blocking bulk Parquet glob with batched per-path calls, reducing stall and recovery time for large warehouses. Tests verify this new behavior. This fits Tier 2 (bounded capability/correctness) but lacks evidence of systemic risk reduction across components to reach Tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's managed warehouse ingestion and DuckLake metadata operations; could improve reliability and reduce timeouts during large import registrations.
review.uncertainty: Assessment depends on actual production file counts and failure modes not shown here; no adoption or incident data available.
